question: At Outfall 001, does the authorization to discharge storm runoffs from storage and production areas, once-through cooling water, cleaning water, and Artesian well water establish one composite authorized discharge to which the Part I Section A limitations and monitoring table applies uniformly, or multiple distinct discharge categories that must be evaluated separately for limit applicability and monitoring obligations?
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf page 3 section part_i (Outfalls 001 authorization clause)
semantic_arguments: enumerated discharge categories in the Outfall 001 authorization clause
single undifferentiated effluent characteristics, limitations, and monitoring table for Outfall 001
Purpose A requires matching reported measurements to applicable enforceable limits
Purpose B requires determining monitoring applicability including requirements conditioned on discharge occurrence
Purpose C requires distinguishing documented no-discharge periods and conditional monitoring from other missing-evidence states
notes: The passage authorizes multiple discharge streams at one outfall but presents one combined limit and monitoring schedule; whether compliance evaluation is keyed to the outfall as a whole or to each authorized discharge type changes applicability determinations across all three purposes.
